label: Counting bytes per object
subgoals: Multiply each object count by its record size
Sum the object kinds into a total
Convert the total to megabytes and scale with design size

label: Indices instead of pointers
subgoals: Count the references stored in each record
Multiply records by references by the 4 bytes saved
Index side arrays by the same object number

label: Alignment and padding
subgoals: Place each field at the next multiple of its size
Round the record up to its largest alignment
Reorder fields from largest to smallest to cut padding
